data.description: The rebuild_indexes() method in cortical/got/recovery.py looks for entity_type at the wrong nesting level. Current code checks data.get('entity_type') but the actual structure has entity_type nested under data['data']['entity_type']. Fix: Change to data.get('data', {}).get('entity_type'). Also fix field access for id, title, status, etc. This will enable 2 contract tests: test_index_rebuild_time_bounded and test_index_rebuild_correctness in test_recovery_contract.py. After fixing, remove the @pytest.mark.skip decorators and verify tests pass.
data.title: Fix rebuild_indexes entity_type nesting bug
